source: main-agent live Playwright walk + interactive probe (POS operator, branch_id=1, :8000)

live_findings.title: Two distinct sandwich categories both render as truncated 'Sandwich…'
live_findings.evidence: Full labels 'Sandwich Cayenne' and 'Sandwich Classique' (DOM-confirmed) both display ellipsis-truncated as 'Sandwich …' in the category bar
live_findings.why_it_matters: Cashier cannot distinguish the two sandwich families at a glance -> mis-selection / slower service

live_findings.title: Tacos category icon = forbidden/placeholder image; Tacos product tiles grey (missing photos)
live_findings.file_line: category image asset for Tacos + item images
live_findings.evidence: Tacos pill shows crossed-circle no-image placeholder; Tacos (6,90) & Big Tacos (8,90) tiles render grey image boxes
live_findings.why_it_matters: Looks broken/unfinished on the cashier-facing grid; harder visual scan

live_findings.title: Currency format inconsistent WITHIN the item wizard (non-FR)
live_findings.evidence: Header/Total '€6.90' and 'Viande supplementaire +€2.50/viande' use euro-before + dot decimal; Formule cards use FR-correct '+3,00 €' / '+2,00 €' in the same popup
live_findings.why_it_matters: ADR-007 mandates FR locale; mixed formats on one screen look unprofessional and are inconsistent with the rest of the POS ('6,90 €')

live_findings.title: Sauce step 'Premiere gratuite' but additional-sauce surcharge not shown on pills
live_findings.evidence: Sauce pills (Algerienne, Andalouse, ... Spicy) show no '+EUR' price; only a green '1ere gratuite' badge
live_findings.why_it_matters: Cashier cannot see what a 2nd/3rd sauce costs the customer -> pricing opacity at point of sale

live_findings.title: Viande '0/1' requirement badge + per-viande quantity steppers is ambiguous
live_findings.evidence: Each viande (Poulet marine/curry/tandoori/crispy) has its own '0 [+]' stepper while the section shows a red '0/1' badge and a separate '+ Viande supplementaire (+€2.50/viande)' expander
live_findings.why_it_matters: Unclear how adding >1 viande via the per-item stepper interacts with the supplement path -> potential mis-pricing / hesitation

live_findings.title: Landing prioritises 'A encaisser borne (200)' list; product grid is a thin bottom strip
live_findings.evidence: Left column dominated by 'PRET A LIVRER' + 'A ENCAISSER BORNE (200)'; the product-selection grid sits as a short bottom strip below the category bar
live_findings.why_it_matters: For building a counter order the product grid gets little vertical space; the 200 count is likely test-data pollution but the layout still de-prioritises order-building
